title: Burn fuel with no trees
kid_text: Use dry plants if there is no wood.
safety: Sparks in dry grass can run. Clear a bare spot first.

steps.text: Powder dry dung so it catches.
Twist dry grass into a nest.
Dead stems that snap can burn.
Look for tiny dead sticks on high ground.
Gather a big pile before you light.

mistakes.text: A stem bends and will not snap.
mistakes.fix: It is too wet. Set it aside.
